items.headline: Federal judge extends block on new USPS mail ballot rules
items.detail: The judge handling the legal battle over new U.S. Postal Service mail ballot rules extended her block of the rules for the November midterms.

items.headline: Rescue satellite gets close to NASA's doomed telescope, even if it can't save it
items.detail: A private spacecraft that was supposed to save NASA's sinking Swift Observatory has managed to come within nine miles of the doomed spacecraft and even snap pictures

items.headline: WATCH: Nat Geo’s 'Moment on the Earth' spotlights the shaggy sea hare
items.detail: National Geographic’s Photo Ark spotlights a ragged sea hare, or shaggy sea hare, as it celebrates 20 years of documenting biodiversity and inspiring wildlife conservation.
